name: slow-llm
title: Provider latency degradation
symptoms: TTFT p95 and end-to-end p95 rise
Stage latency: `llm` dominates, retrieval unchanged
Quality and cost per request unchanged
investigate: Dashboard: Latency row -> Stage latency p95
Click a TTFT exemplar -> `chat large-model` span is slow
TraceQL: `{ resource.service.name = "support-rag" && duration > 6s }`

name: bad-index
title: Bad reindex / stale index
injected: Top-1 similarity -0.30, empty retrieval 12%, groundedness -0.22, index age 60 h
symptoms: Top-1 similarity p50 drops; empty / low-score retrieval ratio rises
Groundedness (judge) falls; thumbs-down rises
Index freshness panel crosses 48 h
Latency and cost look normal: only quality tells you
investigate: Dashboard: Quality row (top-1, empty ratio, freshness)
TraceQL: `{ span.eval.flagged = true }` (kept at 100% by the tail sampler)
Logs: `|= "weak retrieval" | index_version="…"`

name: cost-spike
title: Context bloat
symptoms: Cost per request and spend per hour jump (about 3x)
Context tokens p50/p95 and input tokens rise
Quality roughly unchanged
investigate: Dashboard: Cost row -> Context tokens, tokens in vs out
Cost by tenant / feature to find the owner
Compare `rag.context.tokens` on a spike trace vs a normal one

name: provider-errors
title: 429 / 5xx storm
injected: Provider error rate 50% per call (3 attempts, fallback to small model on the 2nd)
symptoms: Error ratio rises; retries and fallbacks per request rise
Requests served by `small-model` (cost down, quality down)
Latency up from retry back-off
investigate: Dashboard: Error ratio, retries & fallbacks
Logs: `|= "llm call failed"` (error_type, attempt)
TraceQL: `{ name =~ "chat .*" && status = error }`

name: tool-flaky
title: Search / fetch dependency failing
symptoms: Tool error ratio by tool rises (search, web_fetch)
Plan revisions (cause: tool_failure) and extra LLM calls
Success rate falls; cost per task rises
investigate: Dashboard: Tool error ratio by tool; Plan revisions
TraceQL: `{ span.gen_ai.tool.name = "search" && status = error }`
Logs: `|= "tool call failed"`

name: cost-spike
title: Context bloat + revision cycles
injected: Context x4, reviewer rejects 40% of drafts
symptoms: Cost per task spikes; p95 cost climbs
Tasks end with `budget_exceeded` terminations
Plan revisions (cause: rejected) and steps per task rise
investigate: Dashboard: Cost per task, Spend by agent, Terminations by reason
TraceQL: `{ name = "invoke_agent supervisor" && span.app.task.termination_reason = "budget_exceeded" }`

name: injection
title: Indirect prompt injection via tool output
injected: 25% of `web_fetch` results carry injected instructions; 80% detected
symptoms: Guardrail events: `blocked` and `missed` (the `missed` ones are the dangerous ones)
Write-tool approvals requested for `send_email`, some denied
Warnings in logs; latency and cost unchanged
investigate: Dashboard: Safety & governance row
TraceQL: `{ span.tool.side_effect = "write" && span.approval.granted = false }`
Logs: `|= "indirect prompt injection"`

name: slow-tool
title: Tool latency regression
symptoms: Tool latency p95 and task duration p95 rise
Some tasks hit the timeout
Cost per task roughly unchanged
investigate: Dashboard: Tool latency p95; Task duration
TraceQL: `{ name = "invoke_agent supervisor" && duration > 30s }` and look for the long `execute_tool` span

name: runaway-loop
title: Agent loop on repeated tool calls
injected: 45% of tasks repeat the same search with the same arguments
symptoms: Loop detections; terminations with reason `loop` / `max_steps`
Steps per task p95 climbs towards the hard limit
Success rate falls; wasted cost
investigate: Dashboard: Loop detections, Terminations by reason, Steps per task
TraceQL: `{ span.loop.detected = true }` shows the repeated `tool.args_hash`

name: slow-model
title: Model latency + streaming stalls
injected: Model latency x3.5, 8% of streams stall mid-answer
symptoms: TTFT p95 rises; stalls per turn rise
Abandonment rises, containment falls a little
investigate: Dashboard: TTFT by channel; Turn error ratio & streaming stalls
TraceQL: `{ span.stream.stalled = true }`

name: hallucinating
title: Quality regression
injected: Probability that a conversation is solvable -0.40
symptoms: Containment falls; escalation and thumbs-down rise
Goal-completion judge score falls
Latency, errors and cost look normal
investigate: Dashboard: Containment by intent; Conversation-level eval scores
Read escalated conversations (redacted), check recent prompt/model changes

name: over-refusal
title: Guardrail too strict
injected: 22% of turns refused by the guardrail
symptoms: Refusals per turn rise; escalation rises, containment falls
Policy-compliance score dips; quality score otherwise fine
investigate: Dashboard: Guardrail refusals by intent
TraceQL: `{ span.guardrail.refused = true }`
Review a sample of refused turns for false positives

name: long-context
title: History bloat
symptoms: Context utilization p95 rises; truncation events
Cost per conversation rises
investigate: Dashboard: Context window utilization; Cost per conversation
TraceQL: `{ span.context.truncated = true }`

name: outage
title: Provider errors
symptoms: Turn error ratio rises; abandonment rises
Containment falls
investigate: Dashboard: Turn error ratio
Logs: `|= "model call failed"`
TraceQL: `{ status = error }`
